biography: Érico Postal, born under the scorching Brazilian sun in Curitiba, wasn't raised around racing dynasties. His introduction to speed came from the backroads, modifying his father's old Volkswagen Beetle into a makeshift rally car. He honed his skills dodging potholes and outmaneuvering stray dogs. His big break came unexpectedly when a local racing team spotted him drifting through a muddy corner during a clandestine street race. Impressed by his car control, they offered him a spot in their regional touring car series. From there, Postal quickly ascended the ranks, his raw talent tempered by a relentless work ethic. Now, driving for Chevrolet, Postal is a force to be reckoned with, a constant threat for podiums and a fan favorite for his flamboyant style.
drivingStyle: Postal's driving style is best described as 'controlled aggression.' He's known for his late braking maneuvers, often diving deep into corners and threading the needle between competitors. While some criticize his risk-taking, Postal has an uncanny ability to feel the limit of grip, allowing him to push his car right to the edge without frequently crossing it. He is also adept at managing his tires during long races, knowing exactly when to push and when to conserve, a skill he attributes to his early days wrestling with unreliable machinery.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You have to feel the asphalt, taste the victory, and never back down."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Touring Car Championship in 2021 after a nail-biting final race where he overtook his rival on the last lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 24 Hours of Interlagos in 2022 due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a likely victory.
